title: Korean Style Chicken Noodles
description: A Whole30-friendly Korean dish featuring springy noodles and flavored with coriander seeds, this meal is perfect for meal prep and can be ready in under an hour.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together coconut aminos, rice vinegar, sesame oil, coriander seeds, korean chili flakes, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat, then let it sit for at least 10 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the chicken, cooking until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the zucchini noodles to the skillet and cook until they start to soften.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the noodles.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are tender.
Serve the chicken and noodles hot, garnished with additional coriander seeds if desired.
